MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard0Intro.en: The mountain's fire is ours to\nkeep.
MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard0Intro.fr: Le feu de la montagne est à nous.

MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard0Post.en: The ORACLE stands at the peak.

MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard1Intro.fr: Fais demi-tour avant de te brûler.

MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard2Intro.en: The bird warms the whole island.

MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard3Intro.en: I am the ORACLE of the FLAME.\nThe bird sleeps under my watch.\pProve that your fire is worth\nmore than my fear.
MtEmber_Summit_Text_Guard3Intro.fr: Je suis l'ORACLE de la FLAMME.\nL'oiseau dort sous ma garde.\pProuve que ton feu vaut plus que\nma peur.
